title: Issi, Father or Brother of Rabbi Zeira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Moed Katan 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.20b.6-7): “But did not Issi, the father of Rabbi Zeira” — and some say, the brother of Rabbi Zeira — “recite a teaching before Rabbi Zeira…; Rabbi Zeira responded after him,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Issi as Rabbi Zeira’s father or, alternatively, his brother. He recites the ruling about rending a garment. Rabbi Zeira then specifies an exception for mourning a father or mother.
